## Type

- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] `npm run lint` succeeds
- [ ] `npm test` succeeds
- [ ] `TJ_INTEGRATION=1 npm test` (parser/scrape/MCP 변경 시)
- [ ] `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Fixture updated (`npm run snapshot-fixture`) if TJ HTML structure changed
